rule: Discord/Telegram frameworks that need the user's own bot token (or equivalent Telegram/Discord account credentials) are key-gated. Held out of the public catalog pending a later decision.

ids.reason: Self-hosted AI assistant with Telegram chat; needs a Telegram bot token.
Multi-platform bot framework (Telegram and others); needs the user's bot tokens.
MCP covering the Telegram Bot API; needs a Telegram bot token.
Makes Discord an LLM frontend; needs a Discord bot token.
Platform for building IM bots for Discord, Telegram, Slack, and others; needs those bot tokens.
Connects a personal Telegram account over MTProto (user session credentials, not a bot token); held as Telegram credential-gated under the same rule.
Personal agent server with Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, and Teams channels; needs those platform tokens to use the IM interfaces.
Headless LLM chatbot platform built with a Telegram channel; needs a Telegram bot token for that channel.
Self-hosted Telegram bot orchestrating multiple AI providers; needs a Telegram bot token.
Discord MCP server with user/bot account support; needs a Discord user or bot token.
Multi-platform IM agent for Telegram, WhatsApp, Lark, and WeChat; needs those platform tokens including Telegram.
Python Telegram Bot API wrapper; needs the user's Telegram bot token.
TypeScript framework for Telegram bots; needs the user's Telegram bot token.
Node.js Telegram bot framework; needs the user's Telegram bot token.
Golang bindings for the Telegram Bot API; needs the user's Telegram bot token.
The standard Python library for Discord bots; needs the user's Discord bot token.
Matrix-Telegram puppeting bridge; needs Telegram account or bot credentials. Held as Telegram credential-gated under the same rule.
